answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one garden plot. Two agents swap paired receipts by whisper, each tending the other's row and mirroring it on a ledger. Each epoch, auditors replay the mirror; any mismatch burns both bonds. Rented pairs fail: the mirror flags duplicates. Tending a row costs 35, so the k-th fake costs 105; 1,000 fakes cost 105,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest gardener pays 35 once, then reclaims the bond.
